ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to localized clusters comprising less than 2% of the total visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular blobs are mapped primarily on the left lobe (approx. 12-15 discrete spots) and sparingly on the right lobe (approx. 5 discrete spots).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped central depression with a depth of approximately 8% of the total vertical fluke height at the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. The frequency of peaks is higher on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex arc trajectory from the median notch extending to acute distal tips; the leading edge presents a more linear, swept-back appearance.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface; density is highest in the medial-to-distal region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower section of the left lobe, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-contrast, textured white/grey pixel accumulation at the extreme tip of the left lobe lobe, indicating possible barnacle colonization or significant localized trauma.
